title: Story premise EDU065: The Maybe Box Has a Date
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (home organization). Hook: Can this decision wait somewhere that is not the whole shelf? Takeaway/theme: A deferred decision benefits from a bounded place and an explicit review point.
description: A household wants to decide whether a few rarely used objects still belong in its storage, but repeated indecision keeps returning them to the main shelf. A dated review box records the question for a later deliberate decision.
